SUTS-003 — System Locale Data & Formatting

The third SuperUnicode Technical Specification: a binary-compiled locale schema for the OpenWindows microkernel.

SUTS-003 (SLDF) is the third SuperUnicode Technical Specification and a core kernel primitive of the OpenWindows microkernel. It establishes a binary-compiled, zero-allocation schema for locale-specific formatting — number systems, date/time patterns, and collation seeds — that bypasses text-based markup (such as UTS #35 LDML) in favour of fixed-size, byte-aligned layouts (sldf_locale_t) optimized for O(1) kernel execution.

Why not LDML

  • Compiled binary vs. markup — LDML is XML parsed into heap object trees; SLDF is fixed-size C structs in read-only memory, at known offsets, with no parser.
  • Zero allocation vs. heap — LDML builds patterns, fallback chains, and caches on the fly; SLDF resolves from a static table and a fixed index, never touching a heap.
  • Kernel primitive vs. user-space — LDML targets application runtimes and browsers; SLDF gives the microkernel, system loggers, and terminal drivers deterministic rules in-band.

RCCR subtag integration

A subsystem requests rules by its RCCR subtag (a BCP 47-style language code; RCCR is a code registry and allocates no codepoints). The kernel normalizes the subtag (case-fold and hyphen normalization), hashes it with FNV-1a, and probes a fixed 128-slot open-addressing index built once over the static table. The lumer and kupon conlangs resolve exactly like en-US.

Formatting domains

Domain Contents
Numeric Decimal and grouping separators, grouping sizes (3,3 or Indian 3,2), currency symbol and position, negative-sign placement
Temporal Date order vector (YMD / MDY / DMY), separators, 12/24-hour flag, week bounds, long month form
Collation A base weight offset mapped onto the 31-bit SUCS space or the RNUR neography plane, seeding SUCA

Zero-allocation resolution

#define SUTS_SLDF_MAX_TAG_LEN 16U
#define SUTS_SLDF_MAX_SYMBOL_LEN 8U
#define SUTS_SLDF_REGISTRY_CAPACITY 64U
#define SUTS_SLDF_INDEX_SIZE 128U

typedef struct {
char tag_key[SUTS_SLDF_MAX_TAG_LEN];
sldf_numeric_format_t numeric;
sldf_temporal_format_t temporal;
uint32_t collation_base_offset;
uint8_t collation_plane;
uint8_t is_rtl;
uint8_t script;
uint8_t reserved;
} sldf_locale_t;
Operation Cost
sldf_resolve_locale O(1) expected (bounded probes), no allocation
sldf_init_registry O(n) once, n ≤ 64, no allocation
sldf_locale_count / locale_at O(1)
sldf_plane_of / collation_base O(1)
Feature Status
Binary, fixed-size locale blocks Yes
Zero heap allocation on any path Yes
O(1) expected RCCR-subtag resolution Yes
Case-insensitive, hyphen-normalized keys Yes
Bridge + RNUR conlang locales Yes
SCP-invariant separators/symbols Yes
64-bit extSUCS compatibility Yes

Reference implementation: include/suts/suts_sldf.h + src/suts/suts_sldf.c (freestanding C99, no heap), registered in suts_static.

Source of truth: docs/suts/SUTS-003-sldf.md in the repository.
